tasks.title: Weekend job at a bakery
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.subject: Weekend job at a bakery
paragraphs: As you know, you are going to start your first weekend job at a bakery next month. I need your help to plan a few things.
First, should we focus on learning how to use the bakery equipment or on practicing customer service? Which do you think is more important for your first weekend?
Also, we need to choose one thing for you to learn before you start. Would you prefer to learn how to take orders or how to handle money?
Finally, can you suggest one way to make sure you are not too tired after working on Saturday and Sunday?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which focus you prefer (equipment or customer service) and explain why.
Choose a skill to learn (taking orders or handling money) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to avoid feeling too tired after the weekend.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the uniform or what to wear.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: First weekend job advice
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: What is the best advice for someone starting their first weekend job at a bakery?
What should they learn first? How can they enjoy the job and do well?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: A surprise at the bakery
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator handed me the bakery apron, I noticed a small note pinned to it."
